decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster extends the firm's core coolant management line, stays visible on the website, and costs little to keep while its demand among metalworking customers becomes clearer.
The cleaning centrifuge supports the firm's filtration and sustainability positioning and has stayed on the market, so it is cheap to keep the option open while its value is still being established.
The scraper belt chip conveyor sits close to the established chip conveyor business, so keeping it costs little and its sustained presence signals solid value.
The hinged belt chip conveyor is a core-adjacent standard product with continued market presence, and it shares resources with existing lines, so keeping it costs little.
